Do you enjoy turning financial insight into commercial impact? Join Deloitte’s Nordic Sales Excellence Team to develop compelling pricing strategies and commercial solutions that deliver value for clients and strengthen profitability. This is an exciting opportunity to help increase the win rate and shape commercial decisions for Deloitte’s largest and most important deals.

About us

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. The team helps win deals and improve profitability through compelling pricing and commercial propositions for our clients. We provide expert advice on all commercial aspects of client proposals, focusing primarily on higher-value, more complex deals and Deloitte’s most important Nordic clients.

This role can be placed either in Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

What will be your role?

We aim to become the largest professional services firm in the Nordics by continuously innovating, evolving and adapting to meet clients’ needs. To achieve this, we need to strengthen our commercial expertise to support our most complex deals, to our most important clients. You will play a key role in our Nordic Sales Excellence team, and your worksite is therefore flexible within the Nordics.

As our Commercial and Pricing Specialist, your role will be to structure and shape commercial solutions to respond to our client’s requirements and challenges and to help win business and improve profitability. You will work closely with the rest of the Nordic Sales Excellence Team and the stakeholders for our major Nordic accounts to shape commercial arrangements.

The core responsibilities of your role include:

• Shape commercial solutions for complex opportunities, bringing together clients’ needs, pricing options and commercial considerations into compelling proposals

• Develop pricing strategies and structures that demonstrate value to clients and improve our ability to win work

• Build and challenge deal economics through financial modelling, testing margins, assumptions, pricing scenarios and commercial risks

• Partner with proposal teams to design and implement commercial strategies that grow revenue and strengthen profitability

• Advance value-based pricing by helping pursuit teams identify and quantify expected clients’ outcomes, then translate them into appropriate pricing models

• Support proposals and negotiations by clearly articulating the pricing structure and commercial assumptions, and advising on terms and trade-offs

• Build commercial capability across the Nordics through practical guidance, training, knowledge sharing and improvements to the various tools and ways of working

Who are we looking for?

You are a commercially minded professional with strong analytical and modelling skills, together with good business acumen. We are looking for a team player with a collegiate style who enjoys working, collaborating and having fun with team-mates.

We imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience in pricing, commercial finance, deal shaping or a related commercial role; professional-services experience is an advantage

• A strong financial modelling and Excel skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations

• Experience with leveraging AI applications in commercial work, with the judgement to evaluate outputs

• Confidence working with senior stakeholders and collaborating across functions and countries

• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain pricing choices and commercial terms

• It would be desirable, but not essential, to have professional services experience and insights, ideally having worked within a consulting or professional service organisation

• Flexibility to meet peaks of work inherent in the cycle of a deal

• Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

Do you want to be a part of our team?

Please submit your CV and answer a few questions about your experience. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate has been identified.

Application deadline is December 1, 2026.

Please do not hesitate to contact Inu Agarwal at inuagarwal@deloitte.no if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

People & Organization

**Make an impact where international mobility meets people

**Are you experienced in global mobility and international P&O, and do you enjoy solving complex cross-border employment challenges while supporting people and the business?

At Xellia, we are looking for a Global Mobility Expert & P&O Consultant to ensure compliant, people-focused international mobility arrangements and provide practical P&O consultancy across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle at our Copenhagen Site and headquarters.

This is an opportunity to combine specialist global mobility knowledge with broad, hands-on P&O support in an international organisation where your work makes a visible difference to employees and managers.

**Working across borders — and close to the business

**You will join People & Organisation (P&O), based in Copenhagen, reporting to the Director, Global Employee Relations and P&O Copenhagen.

Your everyday work combines international mobility cases, ongoing support for cross-border EU commuters and practical P&O consultancy across the employee lifecycle. You will work with employees, managers, Payroll, P&O colleagues and external specialists across countries, balancing accurate compliance with responsive, people-focused service.

**Own it — global mobility and hire-to-retire P&O support

**You will coordinate complex international employment arrangements while supporting managers and employees with practical P&O advice and consistent hire-to-retire processes at Copenhagen Site and HQ.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Global mobility: Own and coordinate international transfers, assignments, relocations, EU cross-border commuters and other cross-border employment arrangements, ensuring accurate and compliant case handling.

• Specialist advice: Be a trusted mobility advisor to managers, employees and P&O, coordinating immigration, work and residence permits, visas, international employment requirements, taxation and social security with external specialists.

• Compliance and risk: Coordinate A1 certificates, documentation and renewals, support compliant cross-border remote working arrangements, and identify and proactively manage immigration, employment, tax and social security risks.

• Cross-border payroll: Coordinate split payroll, tax adjustments, social security contributions and information exchange with Payroll and external providers; payroll processing remains with the relevant providers.

• Mobility case management and employee service: Manage case timelines, records, advisers and external providers, ensuring employees on international assignments and EU commuters receive timely, reliable ongoing support.

• Hire-to-retire P&O consultancy: Provide practical advice and operational support to managers and employees at Copenhagen Site and HQ throughout the employee lifecycle, ensuring consistent P&O processes and responsive handling of day-to-day P&O matters.

• Organisational change and continuous improvement among other P&O tasks: Support organisational changes and help implement updated P&O processes, guidelines and new ways of working.

Success in this role means international transfers and EU commuter arrangements are handled accurately and on time; cross-border payroll, permits and renewals are well coordinated; and Copenhagen Site and HQ receive consistent, practical support across hire-to-retire P&O processes and employee relations.

**Do you have what it takes?

**We expect you to bring:

• A relevant educational background in HR, Business Administration or a related field.

• Approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience in global/EU mobility, international P&O, immigration or a related specialist area.

• Solid knowledge of immigration, cross-border taxation, social security and international employment matters.

• Experience coordinating international payroll arrangements and external providers.

• Good understanding of Danish employment legislation, employee relations and P&O processes, including the ability to provide practical P&O advice.

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience with cross-border EU commuters and cooperation with external immigration, tax or relocation advisers will be an advantage.

You take accountability for your work, combine attention to detail with a practical mindset and enjoy finding solutions to complex challenges. You build trust across cultures and functions, communicate clearly and understand the importance of both compliance and the employee experience.

**A word from our team

**“Behind every international move or cross-border employment arrangement are people with individual needs and expectations. We are looking for someone who understands both the human and business perspectives, takes ownership, and makes complex matters simple — ensuring our people feel supported, wherever they work.”

— Kira Mondrup, Director, Global Employee Relations and P&O Copenhagen

**What's in it for you?

**

• Xellia isn't for all: There's no rigid hierarchy here, and no one will micromanage you. You're trusted and expected to take real responsibility, perform at a high level, and learn fast. In return, you get the opportunity to shape how things are done, influence decisions, and make a visible impact.

• Make things happen: You'll step into an organization in motion, with clear direction and ambitious goals. Here, you can grow fast, take on more than a fixed role, and shape what's next alongside people who want to win.

**Are you interested?

**We are looking to fill this position as soon as possible. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

**We are your people

**Everything we do connects to our purpose to save lives. Every day, every task we do plays a part in one of the biggest battles of our time: fighting the most powerful bacteria on the planet. But at Xellia, it's not just about what we do - it's about how we do it and who we do it with. We work side by side, eye to eye, and heart to heart across functions and sites, building strong relationships and making an impact. We run on curiosity, trust, and honest conversations. We speak up and share what we know. It's not just where you want to go. It's who you get there with. At Xellia, we're your people.

Xellia is owned by Novo Holdings A/S, headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, and operates globally.

Xellia Pharmaceuticals is the global leader in fermentation-based, non-beta-lactam anti-infectives, supplying Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Finished Dosage Forms (FDFs) to over 500 pharmaceutical companies across 80 countries.

Recognized by the World Health Organization and the European Union for our critical medicines, we play a vital role in combating severe infections and antimicrobial resistance. Headquartered in Denmark, we operate manufacturing sites in Copenhagen, Denmark; Budapest, Hungary; and Taizhou, China, with R&D and commercial operations in seven additional locations globally. As the only European manufacturer of several key anti-infectives and with a heritage spanning over 120 years, we are driven by purpose and progress.

With more than 1100 employees, our impact starts from within. We offer a workplace where ideas, curiosity, and initiative thrive, and where your role evolves with your ambition. Instead of rigid structures, we provide real responsibility, freedom to explore, and support to grow. Together, we shape not only the future of our company and the development of our people, but also the health of communities worldwide.

Further information aboutXellia can be found at: www.xellia.com

About DBI Plastics

DBI Plastics Group A/S is a family-owned Danish company with approximately 200 employees, developing and manufacturing protective solutions for the automotive, machinery and engineering industries. We manufacture in Stenmagle, Denmark, and Swidnica, Poland, and serve customers worldwide, supported by our own warehouses in Shanghai and Detroit. We are undergoing a strategic transformation with a clear ambition: to double the size of the business over the next five years. A significant share of this growth will come from a segment we have not historically approached systematically: the many small and medium-sized customers who currently buy on a transactional basis. This is why we are creating this role.

The role

As Head of Transactional Business, you will have full commercial responsibility for DBI’s global transactional business – revenue, margin and growth across all small and medium-sized customers. This is a business-building role: our channels are at different stages of maturity, and your task will be to structure, professionalise and scale them. You will work through two channels: our webshop and a dealer and distributor network that needs to expand. At the same time, you will transform customer service from a reactive function into a proactive, sales-driving team. As a member of the management team, you will contribute to DBI’s overall strategic direction – not just your own area.

Your responsibilities

• Commercial ownership. Full responsibility for sales, budgets and forecasts for the small and medium-sized customer segment. You set targets, track progress and deliver results.

• E-commerce. End-to-end ownership of the webshop – product range, pricing, conversion, customer journey and digital self-service experience. You run it as a business, not as an IT project.

• Marketplaces. We want to increase our visibility on marketplaces such as Amazon and Alibaba.

• EDI and digital integration. Expand EDI connections with small and medium-sized customers to create a seamless, scalable order flow in collaboration with our operations and IT teams.

• Distribution channels. Select, onboard, negotiate contracts with and manage the performance of distributors – supported by a clear channel strategy that avoids conflict with our direct business.

• Customer service-led outbound sales. Build a culture and operating model in which customer service actively drives sales through upselling, repeat-purchase cycles, reactivating dormant customers and qualifying leads.

• People leadership. Lead the team supporting our transactional channels, providing visible, clear leadership and well-defined decision-making responsibilities.

• Management team. Play an active role in DBI’s management team and share responsibility for delivering our ambition to double the size of the business.

Your profile

Essential experience

• Proven experience in driving e-commerce commercially – ideally in B2B – with responsibility for revenue and conversion, not just the platform.

• Experience in building and developing distribution channels: identifying, negotiating with and managing distributors or dealers.

• Experience in customer service-led outbound sales – you have personally helped transform a service team from reactive to proactive.

• Leadership experience with direct people management responsibility, ideally at management team level.

Skills and personal qualities

• This is a highly hands-on role with a small team, so you must enjoy working both strategically and at a very practical, operational level.

• You are data-driven and take a structured approach to KPIs, pipeline management and channel economics.

• You make decisions – even when information is incomplete – and communicate them in a way others can understand and act on.

• You are equally comfortable in an industrial manufacturing environment and working with a digital commercial agenda.

• You work across borders and cultures and understand how a global footprint shapes sales.

• You are fluent in spoken and written English.

What we offer

• A newly created role with a genuine mandate to shape an entire business area.

• A seat on the management team, with direct access to the Managing Director and a short path to decisions.

• A family-owned company with long-standing customer relationships, high quality standards and an ambitious growth plan.

• A competitive employment package reflecting the responsibilities of the role.

How to apply

Apply on www.dbiplastics.com by 16 November 2026. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Senior Data Engineer

• Full-time

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and AI? Do you have extensive experience in data engineering and want to help shape the future of a fast-growing, international retail company? Then this could be your next career opportunity!

At JYSK, we recognize the importance of data and AI in maintaining our position as a leading retailer. We see a huge potential in leveraging technology to enhance customer experiences, increase sales, and boost profitability - ultimately making life better for our customers and employees.

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our AI Engineering team. You will become part of a passionate team of specialists working at the forefront of data and AI, building the data foundations and scalable solutions that enable us to turn business opportunities into tangible AI solutions.

If you’re excited about driving innovation and creating real business impact through data and AI in an international retail environment, we want to hear from you!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of data at JYSK and play a key role in accelerating AI adoption across the organization. As part of our high-performing, agile AI Engineering team, you’ll have significant influence on technology choices, architectural decisions, and data engineering best practices. You’ll also take ownership of building and maintaining the scalable, reliable data infrastructure that powers our AI initiatives and enables new business opportunities.

If you’re passionate about technical innovation, enjoy solving complex business challenges through data, and want to make a tangible impact in an international retail organization, we’d love to hear from you!

Furthermore, we offer you:

• 
A dynamic workplace in an international company focused on growth, innovation, and continuous development.

• 
A collaborative, open-minded environment with opportunities to engage across all organisational levels.

• 
A flexible work-from-home policy that supports a healthy work-life balance.

• 
Attractive employee benefits, including staff discounts across the Lars Larsen Group and a variety of social events throughout the year.

• 
Access to internal training, courses, and learning opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

• 
A welcoming and supportive culture, complemented by a comprehensive onboarding programme to help you succeed from day one.

• 
A low-politics, low-ego culture where collaboration, ownership, and high standards are valued.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a key role in building data solutions that drive innovation, enable data-driven decision-making, optimize business operations, and enhance customer experiences. Leveraging your strong software engineering background, you will design, build, and optimize complex, scalable data products that provide the foundation for integrated AI solutions and deliver tangible business value.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• 
Design, implement, deploy, and maintain scalable data products across the entire data lifecycle, from data ingestion and transformation to analytics, visualization, and dashboarding.

• 
Design and implement scalable data transformations that integrate seamlessly with existing systems and applications.

• 
Build data products capable of processing structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data to support diverse AI workloads.

• 
Design and implement automated data quality monitoring, validation, and alerting to ensure trusted data products.

• 
Promote and drive adoption of modern data engineering technologies and automation frameworks.

• 
Help ensure data governance, quality, security, privacy, and compliance across AI-related data products.

• 
Maintain metadata, lineage, and documentation to improve data discoverability and governance.

• 
Collaborate closely with AI Solution Architect, AI Platform Engineers and AI Engineers to develop and enhance the data components of our MLOps and AI platform.

• 
Managing and optimizing data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ensure scalability, reliability, performance, and efficient resource utilization.

• 
Working with architects to refine data solution design and contributing to solution planning phases.

• 
Supporting end-users of AI solutions with a "you build it, you own it" mindset.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• 
Holds a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field.

• 
Has 5+ years of industry experience in data engineering, with a strong track record in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and robust data architectures.

• 
Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable, reliable, and efficient DataOps solutions, preferably using tools such as dbt or Dataform.

• 
Has experience developing, deploying, operating, and monitoring data solutions in production at scale, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (or equivalent experience with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work with GCP).

• 
Works independently on complex technical challenges while collaborating effectively with stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes.

• 
Embraces an MVP mindset and enjoy rapidly delivering, validating, and iterating on data solutions within an agile team.

• 
Is proactive, enjoys sharing knowledge and mentoring colleagues, and takes pride in delivering high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader AI Engineering, Florencio Paucar at +45 27794325.

Send us a brief application with your CV by clicking “Apply”. We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

ABOUT US

We believe that our employees are key to our success going from one store in 1979 to more than 3,400 stores worldwide today. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing within JYSK, and we also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in delegation and freedom with responsibility.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

Looking for a workplace where you can make real change? A meaningful job where you have the freedom, trust and responsibilities to play an important role and not just be a small fish in a big shoal? Does being a part of a social, passionate, and international team sound right to you? Join us!

Your position

In your new position as a Telecom & Network Engineer in the Telecom Engineering Department, you will join a multicultural, diverse team of skilled, enthusiastic telecommunication specialists from all over the world. As a telecom engineer with a strong network background, you will create, design and develop integrated critical communication systems for the offshore energy industry. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, or in Gdynia or Norfolk. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel from 10-30 days per year depending on which office you will be working at.

“This is an exciting chance to become part of an expanding energy industry, where you can benefit from outstanding career development opportunities. You’ll collaborate with highly skilled and dedicated professionals who are committed to excelling in their field. The role involves working on diverse projects of various scales worldwide, within a collaborative team environment where success is shared” says Head of Engineering, Technology Solutions, Kurt Thorøe.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As a Telecom & Network Engineer, you will design integrated telecom solutions with a strong focus on industrial network technologies. You will take technical responsibility for assigned systems throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements and design through configuration, integration, testing and final documentation Each project is tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients, providing you with the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge, customized solutions.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Designing and engineering different telecommunication solutions for our clients, which could include network design, CCTV, Line-of-Sight radios and other integrated telecom systems, with a strong focus on network technologies.

• Designing network architecture in accordance with applicable OT security requirements and principles.

• Prepare detail design specification for network to be used for actual implementation.

• Ensuring integration and interface coordination between telecom systems

• Verify configurations and equipment in preparation for Factory Acceptance Tests.

• Performing system configuration, integration and testing as required by the project.

• Following up on subcontractors’ designs, securing technical requirements and interface management.

• Supporting and interacting with subcontractors, customers and other teams across the organisation, such as Telecom Service and the Tender team.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a detail-oriented and structured engineer with a curious and analytical mindset. In addition, you have a proactive and organised approach to your work and thrive in a workday with lots of variation and teamwork.

We imagine that you hold:

• Minimum 5 years of experience within telecom engineering, preferably with strong experience in designing and configuring industrial network systems and a solid understanding of both physical and logical network technologies.

• Knowledge of OT security standards and practices, such as the Purdue Model, IEC 62443, or similar frameworks.

• A relevant degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience from the maritime or offshore energy industry; broader telecommunications experience is considered an advantage.

• Strong technical ownership and project mindset, with the ability to drive assigned systems forward and foster positive collaboration within project teams.

• Strong analytical and technical writing skills, combined with professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

_

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

Are you studying marketing, communications or business and looking for a student job where you can build hands-on marketing experience and see how it all comes together in practice?

We’re looking for a structured and proactive Marketing Student Assistant to join our Brand & Marketing team at Copenhagen Optimization.

You’ll work alongside our Head of Marketing, Growth Marketing Manager and Content Strategist, helping us turn plans into action across digital, events, content and campaigns. It’s a hands-on role with plenty of variety and room to take on more responsibility as you grow.

What you'll work on

• 
Website & digital: Update and maintain website content, event and campaign pages, and help keep everything accurate and up to date.

• 
Events: Support conferences and events around the world — from registrations and exhibitor portals to materials, print orders, attendee lists and deadlines.

• 
Content & campaigns: Support campaign execution by preparing content assets, landing pages, lists and other campaign elements.

• 
Marketing coordination: Keep calendars, project pages, assets and plans organized, coordinate smaller deliverables and follow-ups, and help make sure the practical details don't fall between the cracks.

• 
Creative support: Help adapt or create simple marketing materials and visuals. Experience with Canva, Figma or similar tools is a plus.

Who we're looking for

You are studying marketing, communications, business or a related field, ideally with at least one or two years of your studies remaining.

You like creating structure, following things through and seeing a task go from idea to done. You’re dependable, attentive to detail and comfortable taking initiative. We don’t expect you to know everything from day one — what matters is that you’re curious, eager to learn and interested in how marketing works in practice.

You:

• 
Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

• 
Work in a structured way and keep track of tasks and deadlines.

• 
Take initiative and care about the quality of what you deliver.

• 
Are comfortable working with digital tools. We use HubSpot, Notion, Dropbox and LinkedIn, but you don't need to know them all already.

• 
Are interested in marketing and keen to learn across different disciplines.

Who is Copenhagen Optimization?

Copenhagen Optimization is the company behind Better Airport, our software platform built for intelligent airport operations.

We work with airports around the world to connect planning, resource management, staffing and day-of operations, enabling them to make better operational decisions every day.

Founded in Copenhagen in 2014, we have offices in Copenhagen and Boston and customers across Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and beyond.

What we offer

Approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility around your studies, exams and personal life. You’ll join a small marketing team, work closely with experienced colleagues across the business and gain hands-on experience in international B2B marketing.

We’re looking for someone who wants to stay with us for the longer term, become part of the team and gradually take on more responsibility.

Interested?

Send us your application and CV and tell us a little about yourself, why this role interests you and what you think you'd bring to the team.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position once we've found the right person.

_**Do you want to help shape the digital applications that support digital manufacturing at VELUX? As our new Technical Product Owner, you will connect manufacturing needs with solutions enabled by our top-tier Industrial IoT platform, turning business priorities into a clear roadmap and delivery-ready work—and helping drive our digitization journey.

**_**Meet your future team

**You will join our growing Industrial IoT Platform Team within the IT & Digital Enablement (IT&DE) department. We work closely with the Operations & Supply (O&S) organization to support the entire VELUX Group globally.

This role is a new addition to the team, and you will work alongside the Senior Technical Product Owner who is accountable for ensuring a common approach. You will connect IT and Supply and own an assigned area of manufacturing applications and capabilities within that framework. Your scope can evolve as portfolio priorities and the product model develop, contributing to VELUX’s continuous digitization journey.

**What We Offer

**As Technical Product Owner, you will have the opportunity to shape your part of an evolving digital manufacturing application landscape. You will own the technical product direction, roadmap, backlog and day-to-day decisions, in close collaboration with the business, translating their needs and priorities into a clear, scalable and sustainable product path.

You will connect manufacturing needs with delivery-ready work for technical teams, helping establish a consistent product mindset across your scope. To make that work clear and actionable, you will establish and maintain product requirements, processes and guardrails that support development and delivery.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Own and continuously develop the technical product roadmap and backlog for your agreed area of digital manufacturing applications and capabilities.

• Turn incoming business needs into clearly defined problems and desired outcomes, then shape them into features with acceptance criteria. Keep the backlog structured and sufficiently refined for delivery teams to begin work, meeting the agreed Definition of Ready standards.

• Coordinate refinement and product preparation for sprint planning, make day-to-day prioritisation decisions within the agreed product direction, and escalate decisions outside your scope.

• Be the primary product contact for your assigned scope and coordinate dependencies across stakeholders and teams. Escalate cross-domain trade-offs, investment or capacity choices, and scope conflicts that need resolution beyond your remit.

• Keep manufacturing processes, applications, shared technology capabilities, integrations and deployment requirements aligned from end to end. Shape the roadmap around connected manufacturing needs rather than separate technology silos.

• Manage the technical capability lifecycle from prioritised business need and validation through delivery, operational feedback and continuous improvement, using agreed measures to inform product-quality and lifecycle decisions.

You can be based in Skjern, Østbirk, Kolding or Hørsholm. The role requires regular physical presence in Skjern and at manufacturing locations in Denmark, with occasional travel abroad. When tasks and projects allow, you can work from home up to 2 days per week.

**What You Will Bring Into The Organization

**You bring experience from product ownership, product management or a comparable business-facing role within digital manufacturing, including evolving or multi-product scopes.

You can collaborate with both business and technical colleagues to turn priorities into delivery-ready work, and you are ready to bring structure, accountability and product focus to a development organisation.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, including how operational applications, enterprise systems, machine integration and data interact. Broader knowledge of digital manufacturing landscapes is an advantage.

• Can create product roadmaps, structure complex demand, and translate desired outcomes into delivery-ready features and backlogs.

• Take a disciplined, outcome-oriented approach to product ownership, establishing and maintaining clear product requirements, processes and decision guardrails. Balance standardization and short-term delivery needs with long-term product integrity.

• Have experience working in a complex matrix organisation, using stakeholder collaboration, clear communication and sound decision-making to align colleagues across organisational boundaries.

• Have the technical fluency to collaborate credibly with architects, technical leads and engineering teams.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

A hands-on, mid-level role turning benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, supporting transfer to manufacturing partners and delivering material for formulation, soil and field testing.

About Yngvi Bio

At Yngvi Bio, we are building a biological crop-protection platform based on targeted, non-living protein complexes. Our technology combines AI-guided protein design, insect genetics and microbial production. We are moving active prototypes from biological testing into scalable fermentation, formulation, soil and field validation.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on, mid-level Bioprocessing Specialist to turn benchtop microbial fermentation into repeatable pilot production, support transfer to manufacturing partners and deliver consistent material for formulation, soil and field testing. This individual-contributor role suits someone who has directly participated in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles and still enjoys working at the bench and bioreactor.

Key responsibilities

• Fermentation development. Plan and execute microbial batch and fed-batch fermentations, including media, feed, induction, pH, dissolved oxygen, aeration, temperature and harvest strategies.

• Protein expression and optimization. Improve recombinant protein expression, solubility, yield, product quality and robustness by linking process conditions to biological performance.

• Scale-up and technology transfer. Translate laboratory processes toward 50-1,000 L and beyond; define scale criteria, run plans, acceptance criteria and transfer packages, and support partner execution.

• Production execution. Run repeatable, traceable batches that supply characterized material for formulation, soil, greenhouse and field testing.

• Harvest and fit-for-purpose recovery. Personally perform and improve harvest, cell disruption or extraction, clarification, concentration and the minimal purification needed for testing.

• Troubleshooting, data and quality control. Use structured experiments, data analysis, in-process controls and practical quality checks to investigate deviations and connect upstream choices to recovery and lot quality.

• Documentation and collaboration. Maintain SOPs, batch records, risk assessments and transfer documentation, and work closely with scientists, formulation and agronomy colleagues, quality functions and external manufacturing partners.

You will be responsible for practical process development and execution while helping Yngvi Bio build the documentation and production discipline needed for reliable internal batches and partner transfer.

Qualifications

• Relevant experience. Typically 3-6 years in microbial fermentation, upstream bioprocess development or production-facing biotechnology.

• Hands-on fermentation. Strong practical experience setting up, running, sampling and troubleshooting microbial bioreactors.

• Recombinant protein expression. Practical experience with microbial expression is important; bacterial systems such as E. coli are preferred. You can connect process conditions to expression, solubility, quality and recovery.

• Scale-up evidence. Direct involvement in one or two scale-up or technology-transfer cycles beyond small laboratory reactors, with the ability to explain what changed between scales.

• Production and downstream practice. Experience producing test or pilot material and personally performing harvest, extraction, clarification and basic purification or recovery.

• Education and working style. BSc, MSc, PhD or equivalent practical expertise in engineering, biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related field, combined with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach suited to an early-stage company.

• Valuable extras. Experience expressing virus-like particles, capsid-like structures, multimeric or self-assembling proteins, or other complex recombinant proteins is a bonus. Experience with design of experiments, automation, advanced downstream processing, CDMOs or agricultural biotechnology is also valuable.

What we offer

• A role with direct influence on how Yngvi Bio turns designed proteins into repeatable, scalable production.

• Work spanning fermentation, production, scale-up and the delivery of material for formulation, soil and field testing.

• A small international team at BioInnovation Institute where you can build practical systems, solve difficult technical challenges and grow with the role.

Role details

Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen. The role is laboratory-based and may involve occasional partner or manufacturing-site travel.

Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a short application describing your hands-on fermentation, recombinant-protein production and scale-up experience to info@yngvi.bio.

Application reference: Begin the subject line or application title with Yngvi-BP26-[Surname] Application. For example: Yngvi-BP26-Nielsen Application.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

**The question is: Are you in?
